options.subtitle.message: Grant or revoke access to your self-hosted (local) sync server here.

options.intro1.message: Everyric uses the https://everyric.moref.co sync server by default. Access to it is already granted on install, so there's nothing to do here.

options.intro2.message: This page is only needed if you run your own server. Local server addresses are only used by a few self-hosters, so instead of requiring this permission for everyone on install, it's an optional permission granted only by those who need it. Granting it lets the extension send lyrics/sync requests to that address; revoking it stops that immediately.

options.serverNoteDefault.message: Change the server address from the settings (⚙) in the YouTube lyrics panel — this page only handles permissions.

options.tip1.message: Granting persists until you remove the extension — it's a one-time action.

options.tip2.message: An extension update can revoke this permission, suddenly disconnecting your self-hosted server. If that happens, just grant it again here.

options.tip3.message: You can also check and change site access from Everyric's details on chrome://extensions. Changes made there show up here too.

options.tip4.message: A local server on a different port, or a third-party server address, requires rebuilding the extension to use.

options.serverNote.remote.message: Your current setting is a remote server, so this page's permission isn't needed. Change the server address from the settings (⚙) in the YouTube lyrics panel.

options.serverNote.notAllowed.message: $1$ isn't an address the extension can grant access to. The local addresses it can grant are only $2$ — a different port or address requires rebuilding the extension.

options.serverNote.granted.message: Requests can be sent to this address.

options.serverNote.needsPerm.message: Grant access below to send requests to this address. (Requests go to $1$)

options.grantResult.success.message: Granted. Any open YouTube tabs' lyrics panels will recheck automatically.

options.grantResult.denied.message: Not granted. This permission is required to use a self-hosted server; the default server (everyric.moref.co) works without it.

options.revokeResult.success.message: Revoked. Requests will no longer go to your local server — the lyrics panel will show a permission-needed notice again.
